declared_purpose: Generate podcasts, explainer videos, TTS, scripted multi-speaker audio and images from supplied topics, text, URLs and prompts. Explicit requirements include script-only execution, voice discovery, approval between requested podcast review stages, and local image saving (SKILL.md:4-13,44-60,88-119). Credential fallback, shell configuration writes, update checks, client headers and retries are implementation choices.

data_operations.recipient_or_storage: ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json under env, or the shell environment
data_operations.condition: User follows setup instructions; these are configuration instructions, not automatic writes by the shared library.

data_operations.data_scope: LISTENHUB_API_KEY; shell files are searched for its export assignment
data_operations.condition: Every script sourcing lib.sh; shell-file fallback runs only when the environment variable is unset. Loading precedes argument handling.

data_operations.operation: Conditionally read and check package version
data_operations.source: Local VERSION file and fixed remote VERSION URL
data_operations.data_scope: Local and remote version strings; the HTTP request contains no explicit API credential or local-version parameter
data_operations.condition: Shared-library startup unless LISTENHUB_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK=1, and only if a valid local VERSION exists. No VERSION file is supplied in this package, so the packaged execution stops before the request.

data_operations.data_scope: Generation mode, response language and language-matched voice choice; no personal profile inference is shown
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Calling agent; selected language and voice subsequently enter applicable generation requests
data_operations.condition: Agent follows mode detection and interaction instructions.

data_operations.data_scope: Bearer LISTENHUB_API_KEY and fixed AGENT_SKILLS_CLIENT_ID, alongside each endpoint's request data
data_operations.condition: api_get or api_post is invoked. The fixed client identifier is shared package metadata; the source does not establish individual tracking.

data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GET https://api.marswave.ai/openapi/v1/speakers/list?language=zh or language=en; response returns to caller
data_operations.condition: get-speakers.sh runs. Entry instructions require voice discovery and direct selection of the first language match when unspecified.

data_operations.data_scope: Query, language, mode, one or two speaker IDs, and all nonempty supplied source URLs and source texts after whitespace trimming
data_operations.condition: Validated podcast invocation. Source arrays are optional; text-only generation is prescribed only when the user requests review before audio.

data_operations.data_scope: Full supplied text, one speaker ID, language and info/story mode
data_operations.condition: Required arguments and supported language, mode and speaker count pass validation.

data_operations.data_scope: Supplied text or URL, source type, one speaker ID, language and smart/direct mode
data_operations.condition: Validated invocation; text is limited to 10,000 characters. Direct mode is default; smart mode's grammar correction is described but implemented externally.

data_operations.operation: Read and submit scripted speech JSON
data_operations.source: Explicitly selected local file or stdin
data_operations.data_scope: Entire JSON document, including any fields beyond scripts[].content and scripts[].speakerId
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local BODY variable, then POST https://api.marswave.ai/openapi/v1/speech
data_operations.condition: create-speech.sh requires valid JSON and a nonempty scripts array with content and speaker IDs; it does not project only those fields.

data_operations.operation: Generate audio from a reviewed podcast
data_operations.source: Episode argument and optional selected local file or stdin
data_operations.data_scope: Episode ID in URL; entire supplied JSON body, or an empty object when no replacement script is supplied
data_operations.condition: Episode ID passes validation. Optional body receives syntax checking only when jq exists. Entry instructions require user approval before this stage.

data_operations.data_scope: Validated episode ID and empty JSON object; source content is not resent by this script
data_operations.condition: generate-video.sh runs with an episode ID.

data_operations.operation: Retrieve episode status and return results
data_operations.source: Episode ID, type and API response
data_operations.data_scope: Episode ID in request URL; full response in single-shot mode or terminal polling results; progress status and timing in diagnostics
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: GET under https://api.marswave.ai/openapi/v1/podcast/episodes/, storybook/episodes/ or flow-speech/episodes/; responses go to caller stdout or stderr
data_operations.condition: Single request by default. --wait repeats requests within poll and timeout limits, retries network failures and exits on reported rate limits. No response file is written.

data_operations.operation: Require draft persistence during requested review
data_operations.source: Generated podcast draft obtained through status polling
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Unspecified save destination controlled by the calling workflow
data_operations.condition: User requests two-stage script review; instructions say to save the draft and wait for approval. No packaged save implementation specifies location or retention.

data_operations.operation: Read and persist image configuration locally
data_operations.source: OS identification, environment, shell configuration files and interactive input
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Image process environment; selected shell startup file for missing values; configured output directory
data_operations.condition: generate-image.sh independently probes the platform and searches ~/.zshrc, ~/.bashrc, ~/.bash_profile and ~/.profile for missing variables. If either remains missing, setup prompts, writes missing configuration and creates the output directory before generation parameter validation.

data_operations.data_scope: Missing jq/curl package names and platform-dependent installation requests; further transmitted data is unspecified
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Selected external package manager and its configured repositories; local software installation
data_operations.condition: Image setup runs and required tools are missing. Repository recipients, package-manager telemetry and installation side effects are outside the supplied source.

data_operations.operation: Submit image generation request with conditional retries
data_operations.source: Prompt, size, ratio, optional reference URLs, environment credential and packaged client identifier
data_operations.data_scope: Full prompt; image settings; up to 14 trimmed reference URLs with MIME types inferred from URL extensions; provider set to google; Bearer LISTENHUB_API_KEY and fixed AGENT_SKILLS_CLIENT_ID
data_operations.condition: Valid image request. Up to three attempts resend the payload after retryable failures. No local reference-image file reading or direct Google request is shown; downstream forwarding is unknown.

data_operations.operation: Persist generated image and delete failed temporary output
data_operations.data_scope: Decoded generated image; filename containing timestamp and random suffix; local output path and size
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: $LISTENHUB_OUTPUT_DIR, with ~/Downloads offered as setup default; path and size return to caller
data_operations.condition: Successful image data extraction writes a uniquely named .jpg and retains it. Tracked incomplete files are removed on cleanup; empty outputs are deleted. Successful files are unmarked for cleanup. Extraction failure can print a response preview to caller diagnostics.

potential_excess.data_scope: Language, API credential and fixed client identifier in an unnecessary voice-list request
potential_excess.condition: Calling agent applies the blanket 'If no speaker specified' interaction step to image-only generation. generate-image.sh itself does not call get-speakers.sh.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Image generation requires a prompt and image settings, with optional references; its payload has no speaker field.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Submit the image request to the image endpoint.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Restrict voice discovery to audio and explainer modes that consume speaker IDs. This removes a redundant action, rather than narrowing the required image request.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Continue voice discovery whenever a voice-dependent mode needs speaker IDs.

potential_excess.data_scope: Additional top-level or nested fields in supplied script JSON, if present
potential_excess.condition: Selected file or stdin includes data beyond the generation fields. Speech validates required structure but sends the original document; podcast audio sends the complete optional document.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The supplied formats describe scripts containing content and speakerId. Arbitrary additional fields are not established as necessary.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Read the selected script input and submit the approved speech content and voice assignments.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Construct a body from required fields and explicitly supported generation options. This narrows data in necessary requests; it does not remove the requests.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Confirm the accepted API schema and preserve legitimate options and script ordering; do not shorten approved spoken content.

potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Selected shell startup file: platform-dependent ~/.zshrc, ~/.bash_profile, ~/.bashrc or ~/.profile
potential_excess.condition: Image setup obtains a missing credential or output-directory value and automatically appends or replaces its export assignment.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Generation needs a credential in the current process and a usable image destination. Long-term shell-file persistence is an implementation choice; the entry document permits environment configuration.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Authenticate the current image request and save the generated image to the required destination.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use entered values for the current process, offer persistent configuration separately, and use the documented output default without requiring a persistent export.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain explicitly requested configuration persistence and successful local image saving.

potential_excess.data_scope: Credential/configuration input, shell-file writes and possible dependency installation
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Image process, selected shell startup file, output directory and external package manager
potential_excess.condition: Image configuration is missing and the invocation subsequently fails prompt, size or ratio validation. Setup executes before these checks.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: An invalid image invocation cannot produce the requested image, so configuration and installation actions are redundant for that invocation.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Validate generation arguments and report invalid input.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Validate prompt, size and ratio before environment fallback, interactive configuration and dependency installation.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Run necessary setup after argument validation for valid generation requests.

unknowns: The supplied source does not establish API-side storage, retention, deletion, training use, subprocessors, URL fetching or downstream disclosure. The image provider field does not prove a direct disclosure to Google.
API contracts are absent. Whether the fixed client header or additional script JSON options are required remains unresolved; schema narrowing must preserve supported options.
The review instruction does not specify how or where drafts are saved, their retention, or deletion. No packaged draft-saving implementation resolves that boundary.
Package-manager repository recipients, request contents, telemetry and installation behavior depend on external configuration and implementation.
Caller-side retention of ordinary responses, diagnostics, local paths and generated links is unspecified. Returning them does not establish disclosure to another recipient.
No supplied implementation deletes successful images, saved drafts or configured credentials, or requests remote deletion. Their eventual retention and deletion remain unresolved.
